name: Token Vault
description: Lock fungible tokens in a vault that releases them on a schedule like Bitcoin’s block reward: a fixed number of tokens per block, halving every set number of blocks. Only the owner can release, and only to the owner’s address.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Locks the tokens and holds the vault’s key. Only the owner can release, and released tokens always come back to the owner.

provider.name: Provider
provider.description: A tool that reads the vault from the chain and fills in a release for the owner to sign. It holds no keys and receives nothing.

lock.name: Lock tokens in a vault
lock.description: Lock $(<lockAmount>) tokens in a new vault that releases $(<reward>) tokens per block from block $(<startHeight>), halving every $(<halvingLength>) blocks.

provider.name: Fill in the vault
provider.description: Sets the vault’s schedule and picks the owner’s coins: the tokens to lock, and a coin at output index 0 of its transaction, whose hash becomes the state NFT’s category.

owner.name: Create vault
owner.description: Generates the vault’s key and adds the vault’s outputs. Spend the tokens to lock, and a coin at output index 0 of its transaction: the vault’s state NFT takes that transaction’s hash as its category.

release.name: Release tokens
release.description: Release $(releaseAmount) tokens from the vault, up to block $(nextReleaseHeight).

provider.name: Fill in the release
provider.description: Reads the vault’s coins and state, and picks a plain BCH coin at output index 0 of the owner’s address to pay the fee.

owner.name: Sign the release
owner.description: Signs the vault’s two coins and the fee coin. The tokens and the BCH change come back to you.

releaseFinal.name: Release the last tokens
releaseFinal.description: Release the vault’s last $(<vaultTokenAmount>) tokens and close it.

provider.name: Fill in the release
provider.description: Reads the vault’s coins and state, and picks a plain BCH coin at output index 0 of the owner’s address to pay the fee.

owner.name: Sign the release
owner.description: Signs the vault’s two coins and the fee coin. Everything left comes back to you in one output.

addFeeCoin.name: Add a fee coin
addFeeCoin.description: Send $(<feeCoinSatoshis>) satoshis to the vault owner’s address as output 0, ready to pay for the next release.

provider.name: Fill in the fee coin
provider.description: Names the owner’s address and the amount.

owner.name: Fund the fee coin
owner.description: Pays for the coin from your wallet. It must stay output 0 of the transaction.

lockTransaction.name: Tokens locked
lockTransaction.description: $(<lockAmount>) tokens were locked in a vault.

releaseTransaction.name: Tokens released
releaseTransaction.description: $(releaseAmount) tokens were released from the vault.

releaseFinalTransaction.name: Vault closed
releaseFinalTransaction.description: The vault’s last $(<vaultTokenAmount>) tokens were released.

addFeeCoinTransaction.name: Fee coin added
addFeeCoinTransaction.description: $(<feeCoinSatoshis>) satoshis were sent to the vault owner’s address for the next release.

vaultStateInput.name: Vault state
vaultStateInput.description: The vault’s state NFT, at input 1. It must come from the same transaction as the vault’s tokens.

feeCoinInput.name: Fee coin
feeCoinInput.description: A plain BCH coin at the owner’s address, at input 2. It must be output 0 of its transaction.

feeCoinOutput.name: Fee coin
feeCoinOutput.description: $(<feeCoinSatoshis>) satoshis at the owner’s address, output 0, to pay for a release.

lockStateOutput.name: Vault state
lockStateOutput.description: The vault’s state NFT: release from block $(<startHeight>) at $(<reward>) tokens per block.

vaultRecordOutput.name: Vault record
vaultRecordOutput.description: A 0-satoshi data output with the owner’s public key and the halving length, so tools can find and rebuild the vault.

releasedOutput.name: Released tokens
releasedOutput.description: $(releaseAmount) tokens and the fee coin’s change, to the owner.

vaultTokenOutput.name: Vault tokens
vaultTokenOutput.description: The $(tokensLeft) tokens left, back to the vault.

vaultStateOutput.name: Vault state
vaultStateOutput.description: The new state NFT: released up to block $(nextReleaseHeight), $(nextReward) tokens per block.

finalOutput.name: Last tokens
finalOutput.description: The vault’s last $(<vaultTokenAmount>) tokens and all the BCH, to the owner.

vaultLockingScript.name: Token vault
vaultLockingScript.description: The TokenVault_Release contract, holding the vault’s tokens and its state NFT.

ownerLockingScript.name: Vault owner address
ownerLockingScript.description: The P2PKH address of the vault’s key. The contract releases tokens only here.

vaultRecordLockingScript.name: Vault record
vaultRecordLockingScript.description: An unspendable data output naming the vault’s public key and halving length.

maximumHeight.name: Largest block height
maximumHeight.description: Block heights and the halving length stay below 500,000,000, where a locktime turns into a timestamp.

vaultCoinSatoshis.name: Vault coin satoshis
vaultCoinSatoshis.description: The satoshis on each of the vault’s two coins when it is created.

minimumFeeCoinSatoshis.name: Smallest fee coin
minimumFeeCoinSatoshis.description: A fee coin must cover the release’s miner fee and leave at least 546 satoshis on the owner’s output.

releaseMinerFeeSatoshis.name: Release fee to miners
releaseMinerFeeSatoshis.description: The miner fee of a release: about 1.6 satoshis per byte of its ~1,250 signed bytes.

ownerKey.name: Vault key
ownerKey.description: The key that owns the vault: it signs every release and receives the tokens.

halvingLength.name: Halving length
halvingLength.description: The number of blocks between halvings of the reward, from 1 to 500,000,000.

lockTokenCategory.name: Token to lock
lockTokenCategory.description: The category of the fungible token to lock.

lockAmount.name: Amount to lock
lockAmount.description: How many tokens to lock in the vault.

startHeight.name: Start block
startHeight.description: The block from which tokens can be released.

reward.name: Reward per block
reward.description: Tokens released per block (before halvings), from 1 to the amount locked.

stateCategory.name: State NFT category
stateCategory.description: The category of the vault’s state NFT: when locking, the transaction hash of a coin spent at output index 0 of its transaction.

feeCoinSatoshis.name: Fee coin value
feeCoinSatoshis.description: The satoshis on the fee coin.

blockHeight.name: Release up to block
blockHeight.description: The block to release up to: at most the current block, and after the last release.

tokenCategory.name: Vault token
tokenCategory.description: The category of the tokens in the vault.

vaultTokenAmount.name: Tokens in the vault
vaultTokenAmount.description: The tokens on the vault’s token coin now.

vaultTokenSatoshis.name: Vault token coin satoshis
vaultTokenSatoshis.description: The satoshis on the vault’s token coin now.

vaultStateSatoshis.name: Vault state coin satoshis
vaultStateSatoshis.description: The satoshis on the vault’s state NFT coin now.

releaseHeight.name: Last release
releaseHeight.description: The block the vault last released up to, from its state NFT.

halvingHeight.name: Last halving
halvingHeight.description: The block of the vault’s last halving, from its state NFT.

feeCoinTransactionHash.name: Fee coin transaction
feeCoinTransactionHash.description: The transaction hash of the fee coin. The new state NFT takes it as its category.
